Definition: from G1401; to enslave (literally or figuratively):--bring into (be under) bondage, X given, become (make) servant.
BiblicalUsage: To enslave, to bring into bondage, the verb for what sin does and what false teachers promise to free men from while they are slaves of corruption themselves. Paul says a brother or sister is not under bondage when an unbelieving partner departs, and that being made free from sin we became the servants of righteousness.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe sin enslaves by promising freedom, and the only escape is a new master. Whoever I yield myself to obey becomes my master, so I yield myself to righteousness, whose service is the only freedom there is.
